messages:
sam: Following up on the postmortem—short action list to track reconnects/timeouts/partials. PM: https://redwood/reports/stream-pm-19799 :spiral_note_pad:
priya: I'll own the handshake + backoff change. plan: short-lived nonce, server-verified offset, retries=3, jittered backoff. feature-flagged. due: 2026-04-12.
lucy: observability owner. will add partial-response ratio, p95 streaming latency, and per-region panels + runbook link. draft promql: `sum(increase(chat_stream_partial_total[10m])) / sum(increase(chat_stream_request_total[10m])) > 0.05`. due: 2026-04-08.
noah: infra tasks: enable jemalloc on stream-hot pods in canary, GC tuning pass, and add model-fallback toggle (route to small-fallback when streaming errors >4% for 15m). due: 2026-04-09.
priya: server backoff config prototype: `{"retries":3,"backoff_ms":[200,800,3200],"handshake_ttl_s":60}`. will open PR and tag reviewers.
lucy: alert notes: include per-region labels and suggested mitigations (flip fallback route, increase TTL, throttle clients). will attach runbook.
sam: please add one-line updates to the incident tracker (todo/in-progress/done). i'll run a closure pass next week.
infra-bot: /action created: jemalloc-canary (owner: infra-canary) status: open check-in:6h
infra-bot: /action created: model-fallback-toggle (owner: infra-release) interval:60s ttl:1h
priya: tracker one-liner when PR open: "handshake/backoff PR opened — refs #2301 — in review"
lucy: tracker: "alerts + dash added — pending threshold tuning"
noah: tracker: "jemalloc canary + fallback toggle tested in canary"
sam: thanks team. if any blockers pop up post here and i'll escalate. :thumbsup:
